audit.title: Audit
audit.description: Browse the event log and verify the integrity of its chain.

valid.title: Chain intact
valid.body: The whole chain was walked: every event matches its hash and the event before it.

empty.title: Chain is empty
empty.body: There are no audit events yet, so there is nothing to verify. This is not a failure.

broken.body: Verification found an inconsistency. Review the event indicated and escalate the case to your security team.

reason.unknown: Verification failed for a reason this console does not recognize.
